name: Goblin Rocketeers
description: A goblin racing team in the second Ghirapur Grand Prix, sponsored by Daretti.

description_citations.text: "Daretti". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Daretti bankrolls the Goblin Rocketeers in the second Ghirapur Grand Prix hoping to find new interplanar travel.
timeline.quote: He bankrolled the team in the hopes of discovering a new means of interplanar travel after the loss of his spark.

citation.text: "Daretti", section "Ghirapur Grand Prix". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Rocketeers use Daretti as a decoy; he is taken to a saurid village and imprisoned with Loot to be sacrificed.
timeline.quote: He was taken to a saurid village and imprisoned alongside Loot to be offered as a sacrifice.

relations.quote: He became the adoptive benefactor and unofficial co-captain of the Goblin Rocketeers
